The property is located at 17720 Studebaker Road, Cerritos, California, 90703, is zoned Industrial/Commercial (MC), and is located within the Los Cerritos Redevelopment Project Area (APN 7034-016-037). Redevelopment Agency Conformity Report 2011-7. Conditional Use Permit 2011-6*.
